name: Setup Nextflow
description: Install Nextflow and add it to the PATH

version.description: The Nextflow version to download (if necessary) and use. Example: 21.10.3

all.description: Whether to install every Nextflow release via the '-all' distribution.

java-version.description: The Java version to install as the required dependency of Nextflow. Passed to the underlying setup-java action.

java-distribution.description: The Java distribution to install as the required dependency of Nextflow. Passed to the underlying setup-java action.
